title: Promote image URL guard into SafeNetworkImage wrapper
objective: Wrap URL validation and cached-network-image behavior in a reusable SafeNetworkImage widget so call sites cannot skip validation.
acceptance_criteria: SafeNetworkImage uses isValidImageUrl before constructing cached network image providers/widgets
SafeNetworkImage preserves cacheKey and finite maxAge behavior from L3 and L4
Existing app_avatar, block_card, and block_details image call sites use SafeNetworkImage or the wrapper's provider path where appropriate
Invalid or placeholder image URLs render the existing fallback UI without asynchronous image-provider crashes
flutter analyze for edited display/card files reports no new errors
deliverables: Updated image call sites to use the wrapper
